notes: Exact registry for the migration mode: every production/script legacy import must appear here, and every entry must still match a live finding, so the registry can only shrink.  The final mode ignores it and refuses every legacy import and legacy package.  Owners come from the epic's Python migration matrix; findings in tests are not registered because 08 deletes them with the packages.  07 switched every report/metrics/replay caller to the new homes, so the metrics and analysis entries for api.py, axle_dynamics/contract_run.py, vehicle/service.py, adams/reference.py, cases/kc_quasi_static/workflow.py and the three benchmark-reading scripts are gone; what is left is the element construction of the authoring layer (A1) and the A2-retained compute_static_wheel_loads.
